models_tested.notes: Best balance of speed and quality. Follows section format reliably. Good at comparing actions against answer sheet. Occasionally adds medical advice beyond the answer sheet — system prompt constrains this well.
models_tested.recommendation: Primary model for competition and production use.

models_tested.notes: Slightly faster than llama3.1. Tends to produce shorter reviews. Sometimes merges 'Strengths' and 'Areas for Improvement' into one section. Parser handles this via fallback but loses structure.
models_tested.recommendation: Use as fallback if llama3.1 unavailable.

models_tested.notes: Best review quality — more nuanced, better pedagogical tone. But requires high-end GPU and exceeds 30-second target on most hardware. Not suitable for competition demo.
models_tested.recommendation: Use for instructor/offline analysis only. Too slow for real-time demo.

competition_recommendation.notes: For TMH2026 competition: use llama3.1:8b if GPU available, otherwise demo fallback with cached reviews. Cached reviews cover all 5 test scenarios (good, perfect, catastrophic, empty, wrong priority).
